## Summary
- stabilize two-cascade directional shadow projections with bounding-sphere square extents and light-space texel snapping
- overlap adjacent cascades and blend by camera view depth to remove hard split transitions
- use tent-weighted 3x3 PCF without increasing tap count
- preserve ADR 0036 cascade count, ShadowSettings schema, point/spot shadow boundary, and existing bind-group layout
- add regression coverage for cascade overlap and sub-texel camera stability
- update Phase 50 renderer documentation
